missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend creatine solely for an endurance-only goal; clarify training type and intended outcome.
safety_exclusions: Do not generalize strength/power findings to pure endurance performance.
Do not promise improved endurance capacity from creatine alone.
Do not overlook renal disease or existing use.
professional_escalation_conditions: Kidney disease, reduced eGFR, pregnancy, minors or relevant medication use.
population_and_context: People undertaking pure endurance activity; creatine evidence is stronger for repeated high-intensity efforts than for steady-state endurance performance.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. No protocol from this context; if another indication exists, assess it separately.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Exercise and Athletic Performance fact sheet summarizes creatine's activity-specific evidence; benefit for pure endurance is limited or inconsistent.
